steps.evidence: In an argon filled glove box
The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.
To this mixture, N2,N2,N6,N6-tetraisopropylpyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide (66.7 mg, 0.2 mmol) was added.
The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC. The reaction mixture was stirred for 12 h.
THF was removed under reduced pressure
dried on an oil bath at 90 oC for 30 minutes
